ud3.1:1.1: VAGGA III. NANDAVAGGO. evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya purāṇakammavipākajaṃ dukkhaṃ tippaṃ kharaṃ kaṭukaṃ vedanaṃ adhivāsento sato sampajāno avihaññamāno.
ud3.1:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā . . . pe . . . vedanaṃ adhivāsentaṃ sataṃ {sampajānaṃ} avihaññāmānaṃ.
ud3.1:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud3.1:4.1: sabbakammajahassa bhikkhuno dhunamānassa purekataṃ rajaṃ amamassa ṭhitassa tādino attho n' atthi janaṃ lapetave 'ti. ||1||
